description: Read only: observe sanitized native main catalog cache identity for compiler adoption and retention reconciliation; never compile, apply, accept or delete a catalog

expectations.description: Exact hostname, certname and configured Puppet server. Native Linux/Darwin root or elevated x64 Windows Puppet Ruby required, not Cygwin Ruby. Linux emits schema 1, Darwin schema 2 and Windows schema 3 with native boot identity. Windows reads require handle-bound ACL/reparse checks. Missing, unsafe, changing or non-main caches refuse; a present null code_id is legacy mutable content, not unknown or an immutable release.
